name: GetSubtextNode
label: Extract Substring from Text
description: Retrieves a substring from the original text based on start index and length.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: OriginalText
fields.label: Original Text
fields.description: The full text value from which to extract a substring.

fields.name: StartIndexType
fields.label: Start Index Type
fields.description: Specifies whether to start from the beginning of the text or at a specific character position.

selectOptions.label: Start of Text
selectOptions.description: Starts extraction from the beginning of the text.

selectOptions.label: Character Position
selectOptions.description: Specifies a zero-based character position to start extraction.

fields.name: StartIndex
fields.label: Start Index
fields.description: The zero-based starting position of the substring. Only used if 'Start Index Type' is 'Character Position'.

fields.name: LengthType
fields.label: Length Type
fields.description: Specifies whether to extract a specific number of characters or until the end of the string.

selectOptions.label: Until End
selectOptions.description: Extracts until the end of the string.

selectOptions.label: Specific Length
selectOptions.description: Extracts a specific number of characters.

fields.name: NumberOfCharacters
fields.label: Number of Characters
fields.description: The number of characters to extract. Only used if 'Length Type' is 'Specific Length'.
